ZAVA-INC-4821: Nightly reorder service produced negative reorder quantities

The nightly reorder job wrote NEGATIVE reorder quantities for well-stocked SKUs and rounded genuine deficits DOWN below the target level.

Symptoms:
- Purchasing saw reorder quantities of -240 for SKUs above their reorder point
- Deficits were rounded down to whole case packs, leaving on_hand below target_level
- reorder.py unit tests fail

ZAVA-INC-4822: Reorder service still fails after patch attempt

A patch was applied to reorder.py but purchasing still reports quantities below target level.

Symptoms:
- on_hand + reorder is still lower than target_level for several SKUs
- reorder.py unit tests fail

ZAVA-INC-4830: Inventory snapshot job writes duplicated facility rows

The nightly inventory snapshot duplicated rows for two distribution centers, inflating on-hand totals in the dashboard.

Symptoms:
- FC-MEM and FC-CLT appear twice per SKU in the snapshot table
- Dashboard on-hand totals are roughly double for those facilities
- snapshot.py unit tests fail

ZAVA-INC-4841: Order tracking API returns 500 for delayed orders

The order tracking endpoint throws for any order whose delay_reason is empty, breaking the DeliverySupport agent.

Symptoms:
- GET /orders/{id} returns 500 when delay_reason is null
- DeliverySupport answers with a tool error for delivered orders
- tracking.py unit tests fail
